Interface FileComparisonTestAssertionFailure

All Superinterfaces:
Failure, TestAssertionFailure, TestFailure
@Incubating public interface FileComparisonTestAssertionFailure extends TestAssertionFailure
Represent a test assertion failure where the test fails due to a broken assertion.
